42218.a:
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM golang:1.25 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    --mount=type=secret,id=netrc,target=/root/.netrc \
    go mod download                      # private modullar uchun token
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \
    CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app ./cmd/api
```
```sh
docker buildx build --secret id=netrc,src=$HOME/.netrc -t api:1.5.0 .
```
`ARG TOKEN` bilan berilgan secret `docker history`da ko'rinadi. SSH uchun: `--mount=type=ssh` + `--ssh default`.

42225.a:
```sh kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Pending kubectl describe pod

| tail # 0/12 nodes: Insufficient memory; pod didn't trigger scale-up: ... kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler | grep -i -E "scale.up|max|failed" kubectl get nodes -L node.kubernetes.io/instance-type,topology.kubernetes.io/zone aws ec2 describe-subnets --query 'Subnets[].[SubnetId,AvailableIpAddressCount]' ``` Tipik sabablar: - "pod didn't trigger scale-up: max node group size reached". - requests node allocatable'dan katta — hech qanday node mos emas. - AWS VPC CNI: subnet'da IP tugadi (har pod VPC IP oladi) — prefix delegation yoki katta subnet. - Spot sig'imi yo'q — instance turlarini diversifikatsiya.

42226.a:
```sh
kubectl describe node ip-10-0-3-7 | sed -n '/Conditions/,/Addresses/p'
# Ready Unknown  NodeStatusUnknown  Kubelet stopped posting node status
ssh / SSM ->
  systemctl status kubelet containerd
  journalctl -u kubelet --since "30 min ago" | tail -50
  df -h; free -m; dmesg -T | tail
```
Qaror:
- Cloud'da: node'ni almashtiring (cattle) — `drain` (iloji bo'lsa) va instance'ni terminate, ASG yangisini ochadi.
- StatefulSet pod'i Terminating'da osilsa — node haqiqatan o'lganiga ishonch hosil qilib, keyin force delete.
- Takrorlansa: shu instance turi/AMI, kernel, disk to'lishi bo'yicha pattern qidiring.

# pod ichidan
for i in $(seq 50); do dig +short +time=1 api.payments.svc.cluster.local > /dev/null || echo fail; done

```promql
sum(rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{rcode="SERVFAIL"}[5m]))

42229.a:
```sh
kubectl get pod api-x -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated}'
# {"exitCode":137,"reason":"OOMKilled",...}  yoki reason: "Error"
kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=api-x
# Liveness probe failed ... Container api failed liveness probe, will be restarted
dmesg -T | grep -i -E "killed process|oom"        # node'da
```
| Reason | Sabab |
|---|---|
| OOMKilled | cgroup memory limit — qisqa pik (katta so'rov, JSON yuklash) |
| Error + liveness event | probe timeout (GC pauza, CPU throttling, sekin dependency) |
| Evicted | node pressure |
Yechim: memory'ni yuqori rezolyutsiyada kuzatish (`container_memory_working_set_bytes` max_over_time), liveness timeout/threshold'ni yumshatish, limit va GOMEMLIMIT.

42230.a:
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "50m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "120"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "120"

Timeout zanjiri (tashqaridan ichkariga kamayib borsin):
```
client 130s > CloudFront/ALB idle 125s > ingress read 120s > app server write 110s > DB statement 100s
```
Teskari bo'lsa: tashqi qatlam erta uzadi, ichkarida ish davom etadi (resurs isrofi, 499/504).
Katta upload'lar — ingress orqali emas, presigned URL bilan to'g'ridan S3'ga.

42231.a:
Tarkibiy qismlar:
- **Developer portal** (Backstage): servis katalogi, ownership, "yangi servis" shabloni.
- **Paved road**: 1 buyruq/klik bilan repo + pipeline + deploy + monitoring.
- **Abstraksiya**: jamoa `app.yaml` (image, port, resurs, env) yozadi; platforma Deployment, HPA, PDB, NetworkPolicy, ServiceMonitor'ni generatsiya qiladi.
- **Guardrail'lar**: Kyverno (limitlar, nonroot, ruxsat etilgan registry), quota, xarajat ko'rinishi.
- **Escape hatch**: murakkab holatda xom manifest — lekin policy'lar baribir amal qiladi.

O'lchov: yangi servis prod'gacha vaqt, DORA metrikalari, platform NPS, platformadan tashqarida qolgan servislar soni.
Anti-pattern: platformani majburlash va jamoalar ehtiyojini so'ramaslik; "hamma narsani abstraksiya qilish" — debug'ni imkonsiz qiladi.

42232.a:
Tartib:
1. **Contain:** `aws iam update-access-key --status Inactive`; o'sha user'ga `Deny *`; role sessiyalari uchun "Revoke active sessions".
2. **Scope (CloudTrail):** shu `accessKeyId` bilan qilingan barcha API chaqiruvlar, barcha region'larda (hujumchilar boshqa region'larda instance ochadi).
3. **Persistence:** yangi IAM user/access key/role, trust policy o'zgarishi, Lambda, EC2 user data — hammasi o'chiriladi.
4. **Eradicate:** begona EC2/GPU instance'lar — forensika uchun EBS snapshot, keyin terminate.
5. **Recover:** secret'larni rotatsiya, AWS Support'ga xarajat bo'yicha murojaat.
6. **Prevent:** static key yo'q (SSO, OIDC), GitHub push protection/gitleaks, SCP bilan foydalanilmaydigan region'larni bloklash, GuardDuty + budget alert.

42233.a:
```sql
SELECT pid, now()-query_start AS dur, state, wait_event_type, left(query,80)
FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' ORDER BY dur DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT calls, total_exec_time, mean_exec_time, left(query,80)
FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT pg_cancel_backend(12345);   -- og'ir so'rovni bekor qilish
```
Tez-tez sabablar: yangi deploy'dagi indekssiz so'rov (seq scan), N+1, cache yiqilishi (hamma so'rov DB'ga), `autovacuum` orqada qolgani, ko'p ulanish.
Vertikal scale — vaqtinchalik yordam, sababni yo'qotmaydi; Multi-AZ'da instance o'zgartirish failover bilan bo'ladi (qisqa uzilish).

42234.a:
Tekshiruv ro'yxati:
- **Compute:** ASG/Karpenter bir nechta AZ subnet'ida; topology spread; qolgan AZ'larda zaxira sig'im (yoki tez scale + capacity reservation).
- **NAT:** har AZ o'z NAT GW'si — aks holda bitta AZ yiqilsa boshqalari ham internetsiz.
- **Data:** RDS Multi-AZ (avtomatik failover), Redis replica + automatic failover.
- **Stateful pod'lar:** EBS volume AZ'ga bog'liq — pod boshqa AZ'ga ko'cha olmaydi; replikatsiya ilova darajasida.
- **Static stability:** AZ yiqilganda control plane'ga (yangi instance ochish) tayanmang — oldindan yetarli sig'im.
- **Sinov:** AWS FIS / ARC zonal shift bilan AZ'ni sun'iy o'chirish.

42235.a:
Bosqichlar:
1. **Inform:** majburiy tag'lar (team, service, env) — SCP/policy bilan; Cost Explorer/CUR + dashboard; K8s'da OpenCost (namespace bo'yicha).
2. **Optimize:**
   - Tez: yetim resurslar, eski snapshot, gp2->gp3, log retention, dev muhitni tunda o'chirish.
   - O'rta: rightsizing, Graviton, Spot (stateless), Savings Plans (barqaror bazaviy yukka).
   - Arxitektura: NAT/cross-AZ trafik, VPC endpoint'lar, cache, ma'lumot tiering (S3 lifecycle).
3. **Operate:** har jamoaga budget + anomaly detection alert; yangi dizaynda xarajat bahosi (infracost PR'da); oylik review.
Metrika: unit cost (`xarajat / so'rov`, `/ faol mijoz`) — o'sish biznes o'sishidan tez bo'lmasligi kerak.

42236.a:
Tipik yutuqlar:
| Muammo | Yechim |
|---|---|
| Har safar dependency yuklash | cache (go mod, npm), lock-hash kalit |
| Docker build noldan | BuildKit cache (`type=registry`/`gha`), to'g'ri layer tartibi |
| Ketma-ket job'lar | lint/test/build parallel, `needs` faqat haqiqiy bog'liqlik |
| Monorepo'da hammasi | path filter, Nx/Bazel affected |
| Uzoq e2e | PR'da smoke, to'liq e2e merge'dan keyin yoki tunda |
| Sekin runner | katta instance, warm self-hosted runner pool |
```sh
go test ./... -run . -shuffle=on -count=1 -p 8
go test -json ./... | gotestsum --jsonfile t.json   # eng sekin testlarni topish
```
Flaky testlar — karantin va ticket; "retry until green" — ishonchni yo'qotadi.

42237.a:
```
5xx oshdi -> deploy bilan bog'liqmi? (vaqt, versiya label'i bo'yicha metrikalar)
   ha -> rollback xavfsizmi? (DB migration backward-compatible, feature flag)
          ha  -> ROLLBACK, keyin tergov
          yo'q -> feature flag o'chirish / roll-forward hotfix
   yo'q -> boshqa sabab (dependency, trafik) — incident jarayoni
```
Rollback'ni mumkin qiluvchi amaliyotlar:
- Expand/contract migratsiyalar (avval qo'shish, keyin ishlatish, oxirida o'chirish).
- Feature flag — kodni emas, funksiyani o'chirish.
- Immutable artefakt va GitOps — oldingi versiya bir buyruqda.
- Canary — muammo 5% trafikda ushlanadi.

42238.a:
```yaml
permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read }   # minimal GITHUB_TOKEN
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production          # approval + faqat shu job'ga prod secret'lar
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683   # SHA pin
    - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
      with: { role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123:role/deploy-prod, aws-region: eu-central-1 }
```
IAM trust policy'da `sub` cheklovi: `repo:acme/api:environment:production` — boshqa repo/branch role'ni ololmaydi.
Xavflar: `pull_request_target` + PR kodini checkout qilish (secret o'g'irlash), self-hosted runner'ni public repo'da ishlatish, `echo $SECRET` debug'da, kompromat bo'lgan action (tj-actions 2025 hodisasi).

42239.a:
| Metrika | Nima | Yuqori natija (Elite) |
|---|---|---|
| Deployment frequency | qanchalik tez-tez prod'ga | kuniga bir necha |
| Lead time for changes | commit -> prod | < 1 kun |
| Change failure rate | deploy'larning necha foizi incident beradi | ~0-15% |
| Time to restore | incident -> tiklanish | < 1 soat |

Ishlatish: trend kuzatish, to'siqni topish (masalan, lead time'ning 70% i review kutish).
Noto'g'ri ishlatish: "deploy sonini oshiring" -> ma'nosiz kichik deploy'lar; jamoalarni reyting qilish -> ma'lumot manipulyatsiyasi.
Tezlik va barqarorlik bir-biriga zid emas: kichik, tez-tez deploy'lar odatda failure rate'ni ham kamaytiradi.

42240.a:
Tartib:
1. **Acknowledge** va ta'sirni yozing: "checkout p99 2s -> 6s, error 0.2% (normal)".
2. **Nima o'zgardi?** deploy annotation'lar, config, feature flag, trafik pattern (bot?).
3. **Qayerda vaqt ketyapti?** sekin trace'lar exemplar orqali -> span: DB 4.5s.
4. **Dependency:** DB CPU, lock'lar, ulanishlar soni; Redis hit rate tushganmi.
5. **Saturation:** CPU throttling, connection pool kutish, GC.
6. **Containment:** oxirgi deploy'ni rollback, scale-out, og'ir funksiyani flag bilan o'chirish.
7. **Muloqot:** har 30 daqiqada yangilanish, kerak bo'lsa yordam chaqirish (eskalatsiya).
Error rate normal + latency yuqori — ko'pincha saturation yoki sekin dependency (navbat, lock), xato emas.

42241.a:
| Severity | Misol | Javob |
|---|---|---|
| SEV1 | to'lov ishlamaydi, ma'lumot yo'qolishi | darhol, hamma, status page |
| SEV2 | muhim funksiya sekin/qisman | on-call + jamoa |
| SEV3 | kichik, workaround bor | ish vaqtida |

Postmortem shabloni:
- Qisqacha, ta'sir (vaqt, foydalanuvchi, pul), aniqlanish usuli va vaqti
- Vaqt chizig'i (UTC)
- Root cause va **contributing factors** (bitta "aybdor" emas)
- Nima yaxshi ishladi / nima yomon
- Action items: prevention, detection, mitigation — har biri egasi va muddati bilan
"Inson xatosi" — root cause emas; savol: tizim nega bu xatoga yo'l qo'ydi?

42242.a:
Amaliy choralar:
| Signal | Chora | Odatiy tejash |
|---|---|---|
| Log | INFO'dan pastini prod'da o'chirish, health-check loglarini drop, 7 kun hot + S3 arxiv | 40-70% |
| Log | takroriy xatolarni agregatsiya, sampling (100 dan 1) muvaffaqiyatli so'rovlar | |
| Metrika | kardinallik audit (`user_id`, `path`), ishlatilmaydigan metrikalarni relabel drop | 30-60% |
| Trace | tail sampling: xatolar va sekinlar 100%, qolgani 1-5% | 80%+ |

Boshqaruv: jamoa bo'yicha observability xarajati ko'rinadi (showback), yangi yuqori kardinallikli metrika uchun review.
Muvozanat: incident vaqtida kerakli ma'lumot yo'qligi xarajatdan qimmatroq — kritik yo'llar (to'lov) uchun to'liq ma'lumot qoldiring.

42243.a:
```sh
cat /proc/sys/kernel/pid_max /proc/sys/kernel/threads-max
ps -eLf | wc -l                          # jami thread'lar
ps -eo user= | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head   # user bo'yicha jarayonlar
ps -eLo pid=,comm= | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head   # thread'lar
ps -eo stat= | grep -c Z                 # zombie'lar
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/app.service/pids.current
```
- Fork qila olmasangiz ham shell builtin'lari ishlaydi: `kill` builtin, `exec`.
- Zombie'lar — ota jarayon `wait` qilmayapti: otasini restart qilish.
- Himoya: systemd `TasksMax=`, container `--pids-limit`, K8s `podPidsLimit`; thread leak — ilova kodida (masalan, Java thread pool, goroutine emas — goroutine OS thread emas).

42244.a:
```sh
timedatectl                     # System clock synchronized: no
chronyc tracking                # Last offset, Leap status
chronyc sources -v
sudo chronyc makestep           # darhol to'g'rilash (sakrash)
sudo systemctl enable --now chronyd
```
- Cloud'da ichki NTP manbai (AWS `169.254.169.123`) — ishonchli va past latency.
- Firewall UDP 123'ni bloklagan bo'lishi mumkin.
- Ilovada: davomiylikni o'lchash uchun monotonic soat (Go `time.Since` monotonic ishlatadi), wall clock'ga tayanib tartib yoki lock qilmang.
- Monitoring: `node_timex_offset_seconds` > 0.05 alert.
